_comment: Storage-shaped field-level exemption registry for bin/check_contract_casing.py (Decision 18, record c53289ef; unified with Decision 20, record 25f5fa36: entry kinds column|jsonb|computed|external|table, one registry, PR #650 carrier). A snake_case field in typespec/v1 is exempt ONLY if declared here with kind-appropriate evidence — the database (or the named external/derived source) is canonical per Tier-1 doctrine, so the spelling is an architectural property, not authoring drift. Any undeclared snake_case field — inside or outside the CDLC family — remains a ratchet violation. Malformed registries hard-fail (ValueError), never silently widen. COMPUTED entries carry a dated camelCase remediation target (Decision 20 remediation pairing): unremediated past the target date is a violation. Endgame: the registry shrinking to zero is the --strict target.

execution_id.note: CDLC A2a execution identity; wire mirrors the DDL column (also the A2b census jsonb key metadata.census.execution_id read by exact key in keychain-snapshot.service.ts)

session_id.note: Named text reference (DBA condition 2/3), not the vision.sessions uuid concept; wire mirrors the column

census_id.note: Tier-1/Tier-2 join key; also the A2b jsonb key metadata.census.census_id (exact-key read)

source_namespace.note: Named source_namespace rather than `namespace` (reserved TypeSpec keyword); matches the doctrine transition record convention

doctrine_snapshot_id.note: B1/B3 provenance column; also the A2b jsonb key metadata.frame.doctrine_snapshot_id (exact-key read)

schema_version.note: Decision 20 table: source form — schema_version names the census envelope schema (CENSUS_SCHEMA_VERSION pinned at write, validated on read), not a column; envelope lives in the agent_records.metadata jsonb

asset_id.note: Decision 20 external: form — MongoDB document field on keychain InstanceManifest, not a nexus column or jsonb key

procedure_card_hash.note: A2b finding-card jsonb key (content-addressed card identity)

report_count.note: Decision 20 computed kind — A2b census read-model aggregate over canonical rows; camelCase remediation target: camelize in the CDLC read-model revision PR or by 2026-11-30, whichever first
